574-1981-2415-6772.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-6772.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1322-2023-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1021-4693-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

141-3085-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-8095.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4419-4694-5256-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-5256-7306.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3532-5078-6595-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2292-2908-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2292-2908-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1636-3143-7328.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-7328.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Donatello trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

465-719-3742-4251-7296.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3621-5315-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.
3621-5315-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

112-2103-6496.manaNeeded: {9}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-2103-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-2103-6496.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou and exiling the original Capture of Jingzhou with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Capture of Jingzhou and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Capture of Jingzhou and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-2103-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Capture of Jingzhou is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Capture of Jingzhou is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

725-1329-2034-3652.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Ornithopter, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

232-1235-2493-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-4488-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-4488-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2741-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2741-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

914-3335-6965.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-6965.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-6965.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2173-2324-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1636-6406-6844.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Spider-Man 2099 between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
1636-6406-6844.description:
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-6406-6844.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-4068-6311.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
74-2043-4068-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

3729-6616.notablePrerequisites: You have an enchantment card in hand with the mana to cast it.
3729-6616.description:
Cast any enchantment by paying its mana cost.
When the enchantment enters the bttlefield, Protean Thaumaturge and Ondu Spiritdancer triggers.
Resolve the Protean Thaumaturge trigger, causing it to become a copy of Ondu Spiritdancer while keeping its ability.
Resolve the Ondu Spiritdancer trigger, creating a token copy of the enchantment that was cast.
When the enchantment enters the battlefield, Protean Thaumaturge triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing it to become a copy of Ondu Spiritdancer while keeping its ability.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a token copy of the enchantment that was cast.
Repeat from step 5.

2583-5666-5668-5870.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1636-4050-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-4050-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Inkling, adding one mana of any color.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

549-1365-4853-5231--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-4853-5231--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

2438-2440-3490.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2438-2440-3490.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
2438-2440-3490.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

337-643-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-643-3525-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

349-1744-3096-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
349-1744-3096-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Cerulean Wisps by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Cerulean Wisps targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Cerulean Wisps, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

2417-4068-4803-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one Mountain.
2417-4068-4803-5261.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Siren's Ruse without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Siren's Ruse, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

4639-4644.notablePrerequisites: Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
4639-4644.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion's second ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Tidewater Minion triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

282-1326-3073-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-1326-3073-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Sage of Shaila's Claim that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
The Sage of Shaila's Claim token(s) enters the battlefield, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you can target different creatures with Delina's triggers.

3147-3525-3932.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
3147-3525-3932.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Azorius Chancery and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.

3201-4222-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
3201-4222-4348.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
